pass_1.minimum_design: Use existing objective delivery and scheduling, add no service or full unattended charter, and establish only independently necessary continuity mechanisms.
highest_leverage_assumptions: A persistent objective alone cannot prevent the observed idle state.
A reminder alone cannot carry sufficient durable task context.
The lifecycle needs coordination beyond a simple ordered handoff.
reverse_trace_gaps: No separate failure was evidenced for objective-only versus reminder-only operation.
No conflicting writers justified locking or atomicity.
No external policy constrained deliberate owner grants.
pass_1.blocked_scope: Treating both the objective and reminder as mandatory without distinguishing their roles.

pass_2.effect: Permit design review after clarifying distinct mechanism roles, independent reconciliation, durable phase status, non-atomic handoff, and user-only waits.

kept.item: Design-only native objective as the primary continuation loop.
kept.authority: The user's exact request for a new autopilot goal plus the current native objective continuation contract.
kept.failure_prevented: The design session loses its persistent goal or remains idle at kickoff.

kept.item: One 30-minute reminder as a liveness and recovery backstop.
kept.authority: The user's exact request for a 20-30 minute scheduled push; 30 minutes is the selected lower-cost default.
kept.failure_prevented: Failed objective delivery, stalled continuation, or stale state leaves the design idle indefinitely.

kept: No automatic replacement of unrelated objectives, schedules, or permissions.
removed: Recurring reminder turns while only a user decision is pending.

owner_grants.external_policy: No external policy constraint is evidenced.
owner_grants.control_scope: Prevent automation from replacing unrelated state or escalating permissions; do not restrict explicit user redirects, cancellation, or grants.

permitted_scope: Implement the reviewed existing-capability lifecycle in work-order revision design-incubation-continuity-v3.
blocked_scope: Any new scheduler, objective transport, shared-state service, locking mechanism, or authority expansion.
